entities.summary: Joseph Draper Sayers was an American politician and lawyer who served as the 22nd governor of Texas from 1899 to 1903. A conservative Democrat, he served as the 12th lieutenant governor of Texas from 1879 to 1881 and in the Texas Senate from 1873 to 1874.
